subject.title: feat(hooks): add ACP turn transcript save hook

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor `agent:turn:transcript:save` as a core internal hook contract after the transcript-media and known-event registry blockers are fixed?
rationale: The patch adds a durable transcript-save lifecycle surface and ACP save-ordering semantics that automation cannot approve as product/API policy.

options.title: Sponsor after repair
options.body: Fix the media persistence and registry blockers, add focused compatibility tests, then approve the event name and ordering as a core hook contract.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Keep the PR open only if the event semantics are reduced to a maintainer-approved subset with explicit docs and tests.

options.title: Close or park
options.body: Close this PR or move it under the broader lifecycle-hooks discussion if maintainers do not want this core API surface now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after repair
recommendation.body: Fix the media persistence and registry blockers, add focused compatibility tests, then approve the event name and ordering as a core hook contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ACP manager and hook-contract history makes this the strongest available owner signal for the API decision.
